title: Favorite clarinetists and trumpeter Joe Oliver
summary: He names Charlie Curtis and Teo as good clarinetists and Joe Oliver as a good trumpeter he heard in the city.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Who was your favorite trumpet player in those times? Did you have a favorite trumpet player or clarinet player?
Well, Charlie Curtis, he was a good clarinet player. Teo, he was a good clarinet player. Mm-hmm. Now, the trumpet player. One of them up there, Joe Oliver, he was a good trumpet player at that time.
That was when you were living here in the city, Joe Oliver? Oh, yeah. I knew Joe Oliver. Who? You ever hear him in Chicago?

No, I never heard him in Chicago. No. I haven't heard him since he lived here. He's dead, isn't he? Mm-hmm. They had him playing over the television a couple weeks ago. He shined on that trumpet. Yeah, Joe Oliver. Yeah.
